query:
SELECT b.id, b.booking_date, b.status, c.name, c.email, v.name as vessel_name
FROM bookings b
JOIN allowed_clients c ON b.client_id = c.id
JOIN vessels v ON b.vessel_id = v.id
WHERE v.name LIKE '%JETSKI%' AND b.booking_date >= '2025-11-29 00:00:00' AND b.booking_date < '2025-11-30 00:00:00'
ORDER BY b.booking_date;
